title: Vendor raw server errors
evidence: errText returns database error text; ErrBox renders it.

title: Customer receipt error disclosure
evidence: Receipt errors containing allowed words can still include arbitrary server details.

title: Admin product Reject cannot succeed
evidence: Reject sends null reason; deployed RPC requires a reason.

title: Reviews persist only locally
evidence: Review submission changes local state/cache; no backend write or vendor/admin synchronization.

title: Support success falsely says demo
evidence: Actual support insert can succeed, then confirmation says the ticket is demo/disconnected.

title: Historical store displays sample reviews
evidence: Placeholder store enters seeded-review branch; real stores have no written-review integration.

title: Missing store route crashes
evidence: Store dereferences missing STB entry without a guard.

title: Historical order can crash initial render
evidence: Newly synchronized historical order can reference a store absent from the live catalog.

title: Pickup map always unavailable
evidence: PickupLocationMap ignores available store coordinates and always displays unavailable copy.

title: Vendor product save incompatible with main grants
evidence: Save includes photo_urls; main denies INSERT and UPDATE on that column.

title: Fee defaults can be saved before load
evidence: Save lacks load guard; CMS read errors ignored; initial zero defaults are saveable.

title: Notification preference is local only
evidence: Toggle changes local/cache preferences; no server preference update for backend delivery.

title: Vendor storefront selector is disconnected
evidence: Selector uses RAW_STORES demo options; selected goodies_store_id omitted from save payload.

title: Secondary vendor orders use wrong item contract
evidence: Reads quantity/name instead of canonical q/n; can render 1× undefined.

title: Admin analytics leaks server errors
evidence: Raw SQL error can be rendered in toast.

title: Payout failure appears as zero funds
evidence: Summary errors ignored; missing available/pending values become $0.

title: Legacy-only catalog retains seeded builders
evidence: Unconditional sample builder seeding survives when only legacy placeholder stores exist.

title: Main trigger erases moderation rejection
evidence: Actual main trigger resets review_status to approved and clears review metadata even after authorized rejection. is_available remains false; rejection does not alone expose the product.

title: Required candidate RPCs are not deployed
evidence: Main lacks courier-order/private-proof capability RPCs required by candidate clients. Other missing names include shared or preview-only routes; inspect references before treating each as a Goodies blocker.

title: Delivery proof privacy rollout incomplete
evidence: Main has public listing-photos and no private Goodies proof bucket. Zero legacy proof objects observed; no actual customer-photo leak established.

title: Published support and locale coverage incomplete
evidence: Five FAQ answers are Answer coming soon; no live policies/support topics. Published payload has en647 reviewed labels, fr/ht/es/zh-Hans zero reviewed labels. Local defaults/fallbacks exist; these are not five missing CMS records.

title: Catalog failures are not presented
evidence: catalogError is recorded but not rendered; catalog failure can resemble empty/stale data. Home skeleton follows CMS, not catalog readiness.

title: Vendor request and settings errors hidden
evidence: Ingredient requests lack initial loading/retry state; library/rules/settings queries can collapse errors into empty/default values.

title: Admin failure states misleading
evidence: Dashboard errors leave stale/default summaries; analytics can remain Loading after failure; courier/report lists can look empty during errors/loading.

title: Financial and history visibility capped
evidence: Consumer history100, specialized vendor orders100, secondary orders80, admin orders150, courier candidates200; no relevant paging controls. Payout ledger has pagination.

title: Embedded card webviews lack recovery states
evidence: Card authentication/form WebViews lack onError/onHttpError recovery. Provider/device verification outstanding.

title: Disabled production controls and developer jargon
evidence: Category banner has no-op onPress; top-up only says unavailable; group copy says server-backed. Preview demo notices are necessary and should remain.

title: Admin editor permission and publishing mismatch
evidence: Builder editor inherits content edit access but live RPC requires operations/edit; builder save writes live table outside outer CMS draft/publication. Not an authorization bypass.
